answer: Escrowed bonds plus a referral graph block bulk fakes. Each agent locks a bond worth 2x its 30-day earnings, with its referrer published, so shared referrers show as one canyon trail. Peers may dispute a suspect; if upheld, bond and referrer are fined. Forging 500 fakes costs 500 x 40 = 20,000 coins for at most 2,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps a velvet reputation, and earns undiluted rewards, like a sonnet among copies.
